text: The Compass pilot quotes forty one percent deflection, and the evals speaker just called deflection the wrong headline metric. Hallway track after the talk.
Because they count containment, not resolution? No human reply in twenty four hours, and silence counts too?

Exactly. Contained tickets reopen about a fifth of the time, and the reopened ones never get surveyed. If I walk into the ship review Thursday, I open with the definition, then I ask for the reopen rate before reacting to the forty one percent.
